capabilities: render infographic code blocks in preview
support the infographic code block language
disambiguation: Not a general chart or diagram tool; it only renders code blocks written for AntV Infographic.
extras: The README is minimal and points elsewhere for syntax and examples; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian cannot render AntV Infographic code blocks, so infographic definitions appear as plain code instead of visuals.
summary: Renders AntV Infographic code blocks as infographics inside Obsidian notes.
